verdict: Workday grew revenue 13% to $2.65B, and a one-time $305M tax benefit from moving intellectual property between its own companies lifted net income to $632M.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $0.84 a year ago; includes a $1.52 tax benefit

segments.name: Subscription services
segments.note: Cloud software for finance and HR — up 14% YoY. The 12-month subscription backlog reached $9,034M, also up 14%.

segments.name: Professional services
segments.note: Implementation and consulting services — essentially flat YoY.

opex.name: Product development
opex.note: Building the platform and its AI agents — includes $217M of share-based compensation.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling subscriptions — includes $93M of share-based compensation.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — includes $78M of share-based compensation.

otherDetail: Other income, net $14M. Note the tax line is a $305M benefit (negative tax), explained in the one-time items box.
footerNote: Workday's fiscal Q3 (ended October 31, 2026) had not been reported as of November 7, 2026 — this is the latest reported quarter.
oneTimers: A $305M income-tax benefit from an intra-entity transfer of certain intellectual property rights, part of an internal legal-entity restructuring — worth $1.52 of the $2.57 GAAP diluted EPS. Pre-tax income was only $327M, so the tax benefit is why net income ($632M) is nearly double pre-tax income. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.75 and non-GAAP operating income was $824M (versus GAAP $313M, the gap mostly $462M of share-based compensation).

takeaways.title: Subscriptions keep compounding
takeaways.text: Subscription revenue rose 14% to $2,471M — 93% of all revenue — and the 12-month backlog grew 14% to $9,034M. Workday raised its fiscal 2027 subscription outlook to about $9.94B.

takeaways.title: Profit doubled — on a tax item
takeaways.text: Net income rose from $228M to $632M, but $305M of that is a one-time tax benefit from moving IP between Workday's own companies. Operating income itself rose a steadier 26% to $313M.

takeaways.title: AI is driving new deals
takeaways.text: AI drove more than 25% of new annual contract value, and more than 5,500 customers now use at least one Workday AI agent — the growth story management is selling.

follow100Note: The tax line is a benefit, not a bill: a one-time $305M tax benefit added $11.51 per $100 of revenue, which is why profit per $100 is larger than operating profit per $100.
